@@ -928,0 +928,18 @@ + + If preview features are enabled then some Java objects will have identity and others + (instances of value classes) will not. makes no distinction between these cases + in general, but some specific functions will behave differently if invoked upon + a Java object that does not have identity. Such differences in behavior are described + by the individual functions and events where they apply. +

+ In summary, tags for value objects use value equality semantics, and tagged value + objects are kept alive while tagged, unlike tagged identity objects. As a result, + the event is not sent for tagged value objects. + The and events + are not sent for value objects unless the + + capability is possessed. +
